layers.name: Shared Contracts & Test Vectors
layers.description: Language-neutral API contracts and test vectors shared across implementations: REST API spec, Kafka event contracts, config files contract, and 46 cross-language parity test vectors covering wildcards, decision modes, edge cases, case sensitivity, and the full decision matrix.

layers.name: Coding Standards
layers.description: Language/framework-specific coding standards documents: Spring Boot Java conventions, NestJS/TypeScript conventions, and general README standards governing style, DI, testing, error handling, security, and observability patterns.

layers.name: Project Documentation
layers.description: Root-level project documentation: README entry point, AI context file (CLAUDE.md), contribution guide, and the definitive 513-line architecture design spec covering all internal modules, decision matrix edge cases, startup failover, SPIs, and framework integrations.

layers.name: Spring Boot Authz Library
layers.description: Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.x authorization library with auto-configuration. Contains the full authorization pipeline (token validation, rule compilation, decision engine with wildcard scoring, permission cache, audit, metrics, health), plus framework integration (global OncePerRequestFilter, outbound RestClient/RestTemplate interceptors), cache sync (Role Service HTTP client, Kafka consumer, disk cache, bootstrap state machine), and 13 JUnit 5 test classes covering unit, integration, and shared vector parity tests.

layers.name: NestJS Authz Library
layers.description: TypeScript 5 / NestJS authorization library with framework-agnostic core. Contains the full authorization pipeline (rule config types/compilation/loading, decision engine with wildcard scoring, permission cache, token validation, audit), plus framework integrations (NestJS global guard, module, outbound interceptor, param decorator), cache sync (bootstrap state machine, disk cache, Kafka consumer, role events, Role Service HTTP client), observability (metrics, health), service token management (OAuth2 client-credentials provider), and 21 Jest test suites covering unit, integration, security, and shared vector parity.

layers.name: Demo Services
layers.description: Three demo applications for end-to-end testing: a mock service (Express, provides JWKS endpoints, Role Service API, and Kafka publisher), a NestJS demo (Express host using createAuthz with authorization.yaml), and a Spring Boot demo (auto-configuration with OrdersController, application.properties, and authorization.yaml).

layers.name: E2E Integration Testing
layers.description: Cross-language parity runner with docker-compose stack: drives the same HTTP requests against both demo services and asserts identical outcomes across 14 decision matrix scenarios, Kafka propagation, outbound propagation, and audience checks.

layers.name: Build & CI Infrastructure
layers.description: Cross-platform build scripts for running Maven (Java) inside a JDK-21 Docker container, supporting both bash (Linux/macOS) and PowerShell (Windows) environments.

layers.name: Developer Tooling
layers.description: Claude Code skills (8 skill definitions for pair programming, SPARC methodology, swarm orchestration, hooks automation, stream-chain, skill builder, verification, quality), Claude Code settings, Git attributes, understand-anything analysis tooling (fingerprints, meta, knowledge graph, scanner), and orphan artifact nodes from a prior graph analysis.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start here to understand the project's purpose: a config-driven authorization middleware implemented in both Spring Boot (Java) and NestJS (TypeScript) against one shared contract with cross-language parity enforced via test vectors and e2e tests. The README provides the high-level pitch, CLAUDE.md adds detailed design decisions (decision matrix, rule matching, startup sequence, security), and the architecture spec dives deep into every internal module.

tour.title: Shared Contracts: REST, Kafka, and Config Specification
tour.description: These three documents define the language-neutral contracts that both library implementations must satisfy. The REST API contract covers the Role Service endpoints (GET /roles) and health checks. The Kafka events contract specifies the incremental role-update event format. The config-files contract defines the authorization.yaml schema that every service uses to declare its authorization rules.

tour.title: Test Vectors: The Language-Neutral Parity Spine
tour.description: The project's core correctness guarantee: 46 language-neutral test vectors shared across both implementations. Each vector pairs an authorization.yaml fragment, a role cache state, and request parameters with an expected decision (or compile error). Covers wildcard precedence (`*`, `**`), decision modes (ANY/ALL), every cell of the authentication-type decision matrix (USER, SERVICE, USER_AND_SERVICE), and edge cases (unknown role, missing dimensions, case sensitivity). Both SharedVectorsTest.java and vectors.spec.ts consume these same JSON files.

tour.title: Coding Standards: Java-Spring and NestJS-TypeScript Conventions
tour.description: Both libraries follow published coding standards that govern style, dependency injection, error handling, security, observability, and testing patterns. These standards documents ensure the two implementations, despite different languages and frameworks, produce structurally similar code that reviewers can navigate predictably.

tour.title: Spring Boot Library: Rule Configuration and Decision Engine
tour.description: The authorization pipeline starts with authorization.yaml loaded by YamlLoader and compiled into CompiledRule records (literal-segment scoring: literal=2, *=1, **=0). The AuthorizationEngine orchestrates rule matching with wildcard scoring and delegates to DecisionEvaluator, which applies the DecisionMode (ANY/ALL) against the user's permissions. AuthType enum and AuthorizationRequest model the three authentication types (USER, SERVICE, USER_AND_SERVICE).

tour.title: Spring Boot Library: Framework Integration and Request Pipeline
tour.description: AuthorizationFilter is a global OncePerRequestFilter that intercepts every HTTP request — no per-route opt-in. It builds a RequestContext from validated tokens (NimbusJwksTokenValidator for user JWTs, service token verification), sanitizes inbound headers (HeaderSanitizer strips spoofed X-User-* / X-Role headers), queries the PermissionCache, and emits audit events via LoggingAuditSink. OutboundPropagationInterceptor auto-attaches the user JWT, service token, and correlation IDs to downstream RestClient/RestTemplate calls.

tour.title: Spring Boot Library: Cache Synchronization and Startup Resilience
tour.description: CacheBootstrap implements a state machine with seed retry: on startup it fetches the full role map from Role Service (HttpRoleServiceClient), replaces the in-memory PermissionCache atomically, writes to DiskCache, subscribes to Kafka (KafkaCacheEventHandler), and promotes from SEED to NORMAL mode. If the Role Service is unreachable, the DiskCache seeds the in-memory cache so the service becomes READY anyway (fail-open). A periodic reconciler re-fetches every 5 minutes to heal missed Kafka events.

tour.title: NestJS Library: Core Engine and Config Compilation
tour.description: The TypeScript equivalent of the Spring Boot pipeline. The rule-config module handles YAML loading (loader.ts) and compilation (compile.ts) into typed rule structures. The decision-engine evaluates requests using a scoring algorithm (scoring.ts) that mirrors the Spring Boot implementation segment-by-segment. The SPI module (index.ts) defines the extensibility interfaces (TokenValidator, ServiceIdentityProvider, RoleResolver, etc.).

tour.title: NestJS Library: NestJS Integration, Cache Sync, and Observability
tour.description: The NestJS framework integration: authz.guard.ts (global guard — no per-route opt-in), authz.module.ts (configurable module with forRoot/forRootAsync), and outbound interceptor for downstream propagation. Cache sync mirrors the Java design: bootstrap.ts (state machine with seed retry, reconciler), kafka.ts (consumer), disk.ts (fallback cache). Observability provides metrics counters (authz_success_total, etc.) and health status. The entry point (create-authz.ts) wires everything together from env-config.

tour.title: Demo Services: Mock Service, NestJS Demo, and Spring Boot Demo
tour.description: Three demo services that exercise both library implementations end-to-end. The mock-service (Express) provides JWKS endpoints, a Role Service HTTP API, and a Kafka publisher for test scenarios. The NestJS demo (main.js) and Spring Boot demo (DemoApplication.java, OrdersController.java) each ship their own authorization.yaml with realistic rules. These services are the targets for both manual testing and the automated e2e suite.

tour.title: E2E Integration Testing: Cross-Language Parity Runner
tour.description: The e2e test suite (run.mjs) drives identical HTTP requests against both demo services via a docker-compose stack and asserts identical responses across 14 decision-matrix scenarios, Kafka propagation, outbound propagation, and audience checks. This is the final line of defense ensuring both library implementations behave identically at runtime, beyond what the unit-level test vectors cover.

tour.title: Build Infrastructure and Developer Tooling
tour.description: The build infrastructure: mvn.sh/mvn.ps1 wraps Maven in a JDK-21 Docker container (no host JDK required). Developer tooling includes 8 Claude Code skills (pair programming, SPARC methodology, swarm orchestration, verification, etc.) plus skill-builder and hooks automation — all configured under .claude/. The .gitattributes and opencode settings complete the developer environment.
